title: 纳指100降到16倍：科创50还挂28倍，这轮调整为何更疼
speaker: Lansing (Landing) Too

segments.en: It seems like when it comes to this global AI sell-off, it's hit markets hard, landing.
segments.zh: 这次全球人工智能板块的抛售对市场冲击很大，Lansing。

segments.en: But for China, it seems to be taking a particularly heavy beating, right?
segments.zh: 但对中国市场来说，似乎承受的打击尤其沉重，对吧？

segments.en: When Mimim mentioned, $1.7 trillion wiped off of three of the tech-focused indices since June, why do you think China is especially vulnerable in this downturn?
segments.zh: 正如Mimim提到的，自6月以来，三个科技类指数合计蒸发1.7万亿美元，你认为为什么中国市场在这次下行中尤其脆弱？

segments.en: Yeah. China, it came to the sell-off with a particularly crowded and richly valued AI trade, right?
segments.zh: 是的。中国市场在进入这轮抛售时，人工智能交易尤其拥挤且估值偏高，对吧？

segments.en: If you look at Star 50, you guys mentioned it was down again today, the valuation for Star 50, which is a proxy for China hardware tech, was at 80 times forward PE at the end of June.
segments.zh: 如果看科创50指数，你们提到它今天又下跌了，作为中国硬件科技的代表，科创50的估值在6月底达到80倍远期市盈率。

segments.en: And even with the sell-off that we saw in the last few months, the valuation is still at 28 times.
segments.zh: 即使经历了过去几个月的抛售，估值仍高达28倍。

segments.en: If you look at Nasdaq 100, you know, back in June, the valuation was only 25 times and right now at about 16 times.
segments.zh: 如果看纳斯达克100指数，6月份估值仅为25倍，而现在约为16倍。

segments.en: So it's extremely expensive. And if you look at positioning, because of DeepSeq, you mentioned earlier on, people were really excited about China Tech.
segments.zh: 所以估值极其昂贵。而从仓位来看，由于DeepSeq，你之前提到，人们对中国科技非常兴奋。

segments.en: And Chinese government also sent a very powerful message that is going to support China's national tech companies and to secure self-tech self-sufficiency.
segments.zh: 中国政府也发出了非常有力的信号，将支持中国国家科技公司，并确保科技自立自强。

segments.en: And that made a lot of investors believe that their stock market bets are very much aligned with the policy priority.
segments.zh: 这让许多市场参与者相信，他们的权益资产配置与政策重点高度一致。

segments.en: So that has led to extremely crowded positioning.
And then the unraveling is also very acute, right?
segments.zh: 随后的平仓也非常剧烈，对吧？

segments.en: A lot of these investment thesis are now coming, facing a lot of tests.
segments.zh: 许多市场观点现在正面临诸多考验。

segments.en: If you look at, you know, chip restrictions from US, that means it's harder for Chinese companies to keep up with US AI development.
segments.zh: 看看美国的芯片限制，这意味着中国企业更难跟上美国AI发展。

segments.en: But there is also the side of China's weak economy and harder to monetize all the AI investments.
segments.zh: 但另一方面，内地市场需求偏弱，AI投入变现也更难。

segments.en: All combined together is China has its own structural issues and also very richly valued tech sector, making this whole unwind very, very much painful.
segments.zh: 所有这些加在一起，内地市场有自身的结构性问题，科技板块估值也偏高，使得这轮调整非常痛苦。
